items.title: Cargo securing on the PSC agenda
items.summary: As port state control authorities prepare to step up inspections of cargo securing arrangements, ship operators should ensure that manuals and procedures are in line with IMO requirements and guidance, that securing equipment is in good working order, and that crews are properly trained.

items.title: Sulphur-related bunker claims on the rise amid increased China MSA enforcement
items.summary: Claims involving excessive sulphur content in marine fuels have seen an upward trend recently. At the same time, we are seeing a heightened focus on sulphur compliance driven by stricter inspections by the China MSA, with a distinct concentration of enforcement activity in the Bohai Sea.

items.title: Onboard blending and commingling from a P&I perspective
